**score 46.2** ±1.5

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

api (Novita AI) · $0.80/M blended · $0.8 in / $0.8 out per 1M tokens · [novita.ai ↗](https://novita.ai/models/llm/deepseek-deepseek-r1-distill-llama-70b)

[price source](https://novita.ai/pricing) · USD per 1M tokens, Novita AI serverless chat completions, model deepseek/deepseek-r1-distill-llama-70b (status active): input $0.80, output $0.80. Novita serves it with an 8,192-token context (its own serving limit). Currency: USD. Novita AI official pricing page, observed 2026-09-25.

[context specification source](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B/blob/b1c0b44b4369b597ad119a196caf79a9c40e141e/config.json) · DeepSeek official configuration for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B (pinned commit): max\_position\_embeddings 131072 (llama3 rope scaling, factor 8 over original 8192). Configured maximum, not a benchmarked long-context claim: the official card states no context length for the distilled models (its table gives 128K only for DeepSeek-R1/R1-Zero), reports a 32,768-token maximum generation length, and its vLLM example uses --max-model-len 32768. Observed 2026-09-25.
